label: GFREAD STL bounds, endsolid without name

inputs.name: CMD.KEY
inputs.text:
KFREAD
IN.KEY
GFREAD 4
IN.STL
KFWRIT
OUT.KEY

expect.notes: Same as gfread_stl_bigbounds but the last line is 'endsolid' alone: observed 9 points and 3 triangles: fscanf('%*s %*s %f %f %f') returns 0 (not -1) once the first %*s has matched, so the stale extra facet is read for every ASCII file that ends with an endsolid line.
